I first came across Mehmet in a small article on a Turkish news site, and that was all it took for me to book a flight to Turkey and go find him. For 17 years, he's lived completely cut off from the rest of the world, with no neighbors and no connection to modern life. All he cares about are his goats. This is the full story of the world's loneliest man!
